thread:
claire: quick sync — i'm planning to enable the new routing_cohort flag (shards by user_id hash) starting tonight. need to lock ownership + an explicit rollback handshake. who's taking oncall for routing?
ops-bot: scheduled oncall: eng-sre rotation -> sam (2026-03-21 22:00 PT)
sam: I can own rollback and runbook execution for the window 23:00-01:00 PT. what's the rollout plan (steps + telemetry gates)?
claire: start 5% for 30m -> check p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, and token cost delta. if good, ramp 10% for 1h. abort threshold: latency +10% or 5xx > 0.5%.
juan: can we do a dry-run API that mirrors routing decisions without actually applying them? want to validate cohorts against production traffic.
marta: console has a preview but it's per-route. we don't have cohort dry-run. idea: add a `dry_run_cohort` query param to config_preview endpoint to return decisions for a sample of requests.
theo: tagging telemetry: please include `cohort_sample_id` and `config_rev` in traces so we can group errors. also send a sampled payload (1%) for detailed payload debugging.
claire: agreed on tags. marta — can you add the param + a small UI toggle in console to preview cohort behavior? needs to be visible to authors.
marta: yes. i'll add backend + UI. default sample for detailed payloads = 1%, light metrics always on for 100%.
sam: what's the exact rollback command we should run if we abort? need something single-line for runbook.
claire: use this (dry run first):
```
# rollback to previous config rev
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://console.internal/api/configs/rollback \n  -d '{"config_name":"routing_cohort","to_rev":"rev-2026-03-20-1456"}'
```
sam: perfect, i'll stash that in runbook. also recommend a quick `monitor check` script to run after rollback.
ingrid: small ask — who signs off merge to main? we need a two-person handshake: config author + platform approver. puts responsibility clearly.
juan: agreed. propose: PR author sets `rollout_window` label + requests `platform-approve` review. approver must ack in PR before enabling.
marta: also add a console flag: "require_platform_approval" so toggles can't be enabled from console unless approved.
claire: love that. i'll create a short RFC and attach the runbook template. will also add the telemetry query for quick regressions:
```sql
SELECT cohort_sample_id, count(*), p95_latency, sum(is_5xx)
FROM telemetry.events
WHERE config_name='routing_cohort' AND timestamp > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY cohort_sample_id
```
theo: add `config_rev` to the query so we can compare pre/post.
claire: noted. final checklist before tonight: 1) marta adds dry_run_cohort + console toggle, 2) theo updates tracing tags, 3) sam owns rollback/runbook, 4) ingrid/platform approves PR, 5) ops-bot schedules the window (done).
sam: i'll be on standby and will trigger rollback if thresholds hit.
ingrid: i will review and approve the PR by 21:30 PT.
claire: thanks team — i'll post the RFC + runbook link in #eng-platform and pin. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: note: deployment window approved 23:00-01:00 PT.
juan: minor follow-up — can we capture a sanity check metric: fraction of routed requests that differ from current stable path? small query but can detect misrouting quickly.
marta: i'll add that to the telemetry dashboard under "Routing / Cohort". will keep alerts off default but expose the chart.
claire: great. if anyone sees gaps in the runbook or console preview UX, call it out here and i'll iterate.
sam: one more: please include a short contact list in runbook (pager + slack dms) so no guessing during rollback.
claire: will do. moving to action items now.
